full_judgment: The question that was formulated for consideration in the order granting leave to appeal was based upon the contention that the plan of the D.I.T. to utilize the plot in question for rehabilitation was a public purpose within the purview of the Town Improvement Act. The contention is based upon a presumption that the plan to rehabilitate the displaced persons was also a scheme, namely, rehousing scheme contemplated under the Town Improvement Act, we have already indicated that there is no basis for the presumption that the project relating to the construction of D.I.T. staff quarters was an improvement scheme under the Town Improvement Act. So also there is no basis for the presumption now sought to be advance. We have no material before us to hold that for the rehabilitation of the persons, who were affected, the Board prepared any rehousing scheme under section 42 of the Town Improvement Act.
